description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order under Section 5 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory matter under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains an order made by the Minister of Finance that modifies the levy application on imported maize for a specific purpose (production of "Thriposha"). This constitutes a regulatory action - specifically a waiver/modification of an existing levy regulation - which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a named minister (Basil Rajapaksa), the core content is about regulatory modification rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
